_comment: Bounds for scripts/gallery-matrix/parity.py (Linux render judged against the Mac render, shotdiff spec keys). default holds for every entry; entries.<id> overrides it, with a why. mac_only: true says the Linux gallery is not the verdict for that entry. Calibrated from the first paired run; until then default is shotdiff's own spec loosened for font rasterisation (antialiasing moves many pixels a little).
